en.title: Claude vs Codex in October 2026: Which Wins at $100?
en.titleCore: Claude Max vs ChatGPT Pro for coding in October 2026: we priced both from our logs
en.description: Claude Max 5x held $658 to $953 of API value a week, Codex Pro $100 held $175. Priced per task, it is close to a tie. Logs, CSV and verdict for October 2026.
en.body:
Same $100 a month, two very different deals. We priced every Claude Code turn on our Claude Max 5x plan and every Codex request on our ChatGPT Pro $100 plan, at API list prices, from our own logs. A Claude week held $644 to $953 of API-priced usage. A full Codex window held a median $175. Claude looks 4x to 5x bigger. Then you price the work, and it is roughly a tie.

  • Raw API value per week: Claude Max 5x $658 to $953. Codex Pro $100 $175. Claude wins on paper.
  • Cost per task: Opus 5.5 spent $0.87 on a benchmark task GPT-6 Sol did for $0.26. Codex is 3.3x cheaper per job.
  • Tasks per week: about 756 to 1,005 on Claude, about 673 on Codex. Claude ahead by a nose.
  • The catch on each side: Claude's weekly cap is now real. We hit it for the first time on October 9. Codex Pro has no 5-hour limit, and resets can multiply it.

What changed in October

The last time we ran this comparison, the Claude side looked untouchable: a Max 5x week was worth at least $1,217 at API prices and we never found its ceiling. Three things moved since.

  • Anthropic made Claude cheaper per token, so the same quota is worth fewer dollars. Opus 5.5 lists at $4 input and $20 output per million tokens, against $5 and $25 for Opus 5. Its cache reads cost $0.20 instead of $0.50, and a heavy agent session is mostly cache reads.
  • The weekly promo ended. From September 14, Claude Code weekly limits carry a permanent 25% bonus, replacing the temporary 50% one. That is about 17% less than the boosted level.
  • OpenAI cut Pro $200. From October 30, ChatGPT Pro $200 drops from 20x to 10x Plus for Codex. Existing subscribers keep current limits through October 29 and get a one-time $2,500 credit that expires at year end. A new Pro $500 tier is the only one with Ultrafast, and its multiplier is unpublished.

The Claude side: the weekly cap is now binding

We are on Max 5x. Since our logs restart on September 11 (older logs were pruned by retention), we priced four complete weekly windows. Windows start Friday 14:00 UTC, the reset time Claude Code reports.

Week startingAPI valueTurnsMain modelsWeekly limit hit?
Sep 11$6446,844Opus 5No
Sep 18$95313,474Opus 5, Opus 5.5No
Sep 25$87423,337Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5No
Oct 2$65812,489Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, Fable 5.1Yes, 16 minutes before reset

So the cap sits somewhere between $658 and well above $874 of API value, depending on the mix. The week we hit it was not our biggest week in dollars. It had the most Fable 5.1, which lists at 2.5x Opus 5.5 and may draw on the quota harder than its dollar share suggests. Sessions also include claude.ai chat, which shares the same pool but does not appear in Claude Code logs.

Separately, we hit the rolling 5-hour session limit 17 times between September 10 and October 9. That is the real day-to-day friction on Claude: a long session stalls mid-task, and you wait.

Raw data: claude-max-5x-weekly-windows.csv.

The Codex side: smaller windows, cheaper work

Six full Codex windows on Pro $100 priced between $100 and $234, median $175. That is 2.6x a $67 Plus week, not the advertised 5x (full breakdown here). But Codex does the same job with far fewer dollars:

TestClaudeCodexGap
DataCamp: same Tetris build, API costOpus 5.5: $0.87GPT-6 Sol: $0.263.3x
codeongrass: same plugin feature, tokensClaude Code: 6.2MCodex: 1.5M4.2x
Terminal-Bench 4.0, scoreOpus 5.5: 66.4%GPT-6 Sol: 60.5%Claude +6 pts

Pro plans also have no 5-hour limit, and Codex has resets. In 12 days we got eight windows instead of two, worth $1,211 of API value. Resets are not something you can plan around, so we leave them out of the baseline below.

More for your buck: tasks per week

Dollars of API value are the wrong unit when one model needs 3x the tokens for the same job. Divide each plan's weekly value by its cost per task:

PlanPrice / monthAPI value / weekTasks / week
ChatGPT Plus$20$67about 258
Claude Max 5x$100$658 to $874about 756 to 1,005
ChatGPT Pro $100$100$175about 673
ChatGPT Pro $200, until Oct 29$20020x labelabout 5,154 (earlier study)
ChatGPT Pro $200, from Oct 30 (label)$200$670about 2,577
ChatGPT Pro $200, from Oct 30 (our ratio)$200about $351about 1,350

One task here means one benchmark-sized coding job. Your tasks will be bigger or smaller, but the ratios hold as long as the 3.3x cost gap does.

Verdict for October 2026

  • At $20: ChatGPT Plus. 258 tasks a week is the best unit price on the board. We did not measure Claude Pro, but its weekly pool is a fifth of Max 5x.
  • At $100: a near tie. Claude Max 5x does slightly more tasks and wins on hard, ambiguous problems. Codex Pro $100 never stalls on a 5-hour limit, and a reset can triple a week. If your work is a queue of well-specified tickets, take Codex. If it is gnarly debugging and design, take Claude.
  • At $120: Claude Max 5x plus ChatGPT Plus is our pick. Route the hard thinking to Opus, the volume to Codex, and you rarely hit either wall.
  • At $200: until October 29, ChatGPT Pro $200 is the clear volume winner. From October 30, at our measured ratio, it lands near Claude Max 20x. Lock in the $2,500 credit before then if you are already subscribed.

What this does not show

This is one heavy user's logs, not a panel. Claude logs before September 11 were pruned, so we could not re-check the August weeks behind our earlier $1,217 floor. Claude.ai chat shares the weekly pool but is not in the logs, so the cap may sit higher than $658 for pure Claude Code use. Dollar figures are API-equivalent value at list price, not money we paid. Both vendors meter in their own units, and neither publishes the conversion.

faq.question: Is Claude or Codex better value in October 2026?
faq.answer: At $100 a month it is close to a tie. Claude Max 5x held $658 to $953 of API value a week in our logs, Codex Pro $100 held $175, but Codex does the same task for about a third of the cost, so both land around 700 to 1,000 benchmark-sized tasks a week.

faq.question: How much usage does Claude Max 5x include per week?
faq.answer: In our logs, between $658 and $953 of API-priced Claude Code usage. We hit the weekly limit at $658 in a week heavy on Fable 5.1, and did not hit it in weeks worth $874 and $953.

faq.question: Is Opus 5.5 better than GPT-6 Sol for coding?
faq.answer: On Terminal-Bench 4.0 Opus 5.5 scores 66.4% against 60.5% for GPT-6 Sol, but GPT-6 Sol completed a DataCamp benchmark task for $0.26 versus $0.87. Claude is worth it on hard problems, Codex on volume.

faq.question: What is the best AI coding plan for $120 a month?
faq.answer: Claude Max 5x plus ChatGPT Plus. Use Opus for hard reasoning and Codex for routine volume, and you rarely hit either plan's limit.
